<div class="card-body">
'''Snowspeeder''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Combat Vehicle]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">スノースピーダー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットと乗客を合計で1名乗せられる。能力値1の専属パイロットが乗っている。ホスの位置に対してのみリアクションとして移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Snowspeeder-PSA-82917286.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">改造を加えたインコムＴ－４７エアスピーダー。密閉型。低温対策としてリバルサー・コイルにヒーターを追加。反乱軍は改造型スピーダーに環境に即した呼び名をつける。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Snowspeeder.

'''Card text:'''
May carry a total of 1 pilot or passenger. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard. May move as a react only to Hoth locations.

'''Lore:'''
A modified Incom T-47 airspeeder. Enclosed. Heaters were added to the reversal coils as a cold-weather measure. Rebels give converted speeders names matching the environment.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore prints リバルサー coils, not regulator coils, and underlines 密閉型.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Snowspeeder]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
